note: Independent re-judgment against RFC 5176 Section 2.3 and HEAD code (coa.go oneSession). TestRFC5176CoAMatchingSeveralSessionsIsNAKed and TestRFC5176MultipleMatchingSessionsNAKed drive both CoA-Request and Disconnect-Request matching two alice sessions, asserting CoA-NAK/Disconnect-NAK with Error-Cause 508 and zero bus events or teardowns. TestRFC5176CoAMatchingOneSessionIsACKed and the negative half of TestRFC5176MultipleMatchingSessionsNAKed narrow the same requests with NAS-Port 21 to one session and assert ACK with one event/teardown.
